T1.candidate_revision: Repeated pseudonymous individual encounters and explicit double-observer match uncertainty; independently validate false-split/false-merge rates and geographic boundaries.
T1.remaining_methodological_blocker: Photo-ID audit dataset, mark-resight open-population/SECR assumptions and power simulations need qualified ecological methods review.

T2.candidate_revision: Use non-invasive repeat visual identities, observed offspring of resident mothers, coarse zone transition evidence, and explicitly consented deidentified voluntary reports; do not mandate collars, genetics or invasive household tracking.
T2.remaining_methodological_blocker: Origin labels alone do not establish immigration or abandonment; unobserved neonatal loss and co-occurrence remain. Genetic parentage or telemetry requires a separate welfare/ethics feasibility decision.

T3.candidate_revision: Collect independent paired observer encounter histories, match confidence, distance and effort covariates, reproductive-state categories and repeat transect visits; do not assume g(0)=1.
T3.remaining_methodological_blocker: MRDS model family, conditional detection dependence, responsive movement, g(0), den availability and population closure require qualified simulation/calibration. No fitting or effect inference happens here.

boundaries: Counts are source records only and do not estimate latent abundance.
Observer overlap is descriptive; its ratio is NOT g(0) or a capture-recapture estimate.
A double-observer setup alone does not establish observer independence, detection at zero or model validity.
Both arrivals and local births can co-occur; event labels never estimate contribution to population change.
Original dog photo/personal owner data and precise GPS are forbidden in this interchange.
Thresholds are pilot format heuristics, not calibrated power criteria or animal-welfare approval.
No original dog-level field data are implied when synthetic=true.

next_evidence_gate: Independent ecology/animal-welfare and privacy protocol review, pilot double-observer matching and coverage calibration, then real anonymized repeated field data.
scope: Demonstration of minimum observable data and quality preconditions only; not the original data, author validation or a statistically tested MRDS model.
